
Hoshimiya Shrine, meaning Star Palace Shrine, is a name of Shinto Shrines primarily associated with [[Futsunushi]]. They are thus related to Katori Shrines.

Iwasaku and Nesaku are also worshipped there was with [[Amatsu-Mikaboshi]]
'''Hoshimiya Shrine''' (星宮神社, *Hoshinomiya Jinja* or *Hoshimiya Jinja*) is the name of several Shinto shrines in Japan.

== List of Hoshimiya Shrines ==
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Sano) – Located in Ōkura-chō (Sano), Sano, Tochigi, Tochigi Prefecture.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Shimotsuke) – Located in Shimotsuke, Tochigi, Tochigi Prefecture, in the Shitakoyama area. Also known as Shitakoyama Hoshimiya Shrine.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Tochigi, Azusa) – Located in Azusa, Tochigi, Tochigi, Tochigi, Tochigi Prefecture.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Tochigi, Hirayanagi) – Located in Hirayanagi, Tochigi, Tochigi City, Tochigi Prefecture. Also known as Hirayanagi Hoshimiya Shrine.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Tochigi, Onoguchi) – Located in Onoguchi-chō, Tochigi City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Tochigi, Ōhiramachi-Tomida) – Located in Ōhiramachi-Tomida, Tochigi City, Tochigi Prefecture. Also known as Tomida Hoshimiya Shrine.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Ryūgasaki) – Located in Wakashiba-chō, Ryūgasaki, Ibaraki, Ibaraki Prefecture.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Hannō, Akazawa) – Located in Akazawa, Hannō, Hannō, Saitama, Saitama Prefecture.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Hannō, Kaminaguri) – Located in Kaminaguri, Hannō City, Saitama Prefecture.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Gujo) – Located in Minami-chō, Takasago, Gujo, Gifu, Gifu Prefecture.
* Hoshimiya Shrine (Nagoya) – Located in Honhoshizakichō, Minami-ku, Nagoya, Nagoya, Aichi, Aichi Prefecture. Also known as Hoshizakimiya Shrine.
* Kawahara Shrine (Kiyosu) – Located in Ahara-Miyahigashi, Kiyosu, Aichi, Aichi Prefecture. Also known as Hoshinomiya Shrine.
